subject: Docathon organizer request: short-notice credit top-up and trial extension
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya@codeforcommunity.org>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 30 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Request: short-notice credit top-up & trial extension for Docathon week

Hi Evelyn,

Thanks again for the credits you provided for last month’s mini-sprint — it made a huge difference. We have an uptick: several additional university teams were accepted for the Docathon (May 12-14) and we’re likely to exceed the trial allotment for compute. Two asks:

1) Can Redwood authorize a short-notice top-up (20k token-equivalent / temporary slot increase) to cover extra GPU time for the event?
2) If possible, extend the organizer trial window by 10 days so the late teams can finish end-to-end demos without being throttled.

I’ve attached the updated budget and event agenda; Alejandro from DevSprint (copartner) is cc’d. We can run an abbreviated technical walkthrough with one of your engineers on Monday if that helps.

Quick background: we run code-along workshop sessions and the extra teams mean roughly ~120 extra model runs across two days. The organizers are volunteers and we want to ensure a smooth demo night.

Appreciate any help — we’re happy to surface Redwood in event comms and include a sponsor slide.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Organizer, Code for Community
priya@codeforcommunity.org

Attachments: docathon-budget-ask.xlsx (spreadsheet), event-agenda-v2.pdf (PDF)

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@codeforcommunity.org>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 30 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Request: short-notice credit top-up & trial extension for Docathon week

Hi Priya — thanks for the clear note and the attachments.

We’re keen to support this — the community uplift is exactly the sort of event we prioritize. I’ll start an internal approval thread and loop in Marissa (community programs) and Karthik (program ops) to get a sense of whether we can do a temporary top-up + short extension.

Can you confirm the absolute deadline to provision the extra capacity? Also: is there any PII in the sample runs we should be aware of (student names / emails) or is everything anonymized?

I’ll follow up within 24 hours with next steps.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Community Programs Manager | Redwood Inference
Evelyn.Hart@redwood.ai
